name: JobSearch Pal
description: Save job posts from the page you're on, track each application's status, set reminders, back up and export. Free and local-only.

brief.audience: Job seekers applying to many roles across job boards and company career sites who want one private place to track them.
brief.problem: Applications get scattered across tabs, boards and spreadsheets; people lose track of where they applied, what stage each is at and when to follow up.
features: Save the posting on the current page with one click: reads schema.org JobPosting data and supported job-board pages, only when the user clicks
Side panel listing saved jobs with an editable application status (saved, applied, interviewing, offer, rejected, withdrawn) and notes
Per-application follow-up reminders shown as Chrome notifications
Back up and restore all data as a JSON file, and export to CSV
Everything stored locally in chrome.storage; no network requests
outOfScope: Any network requests, servers, accounts or sync services
Auto-applying, form filling or submitting anything on the user's behalf
Background reading of pages or always-on content scripts / host permissions
